Name: Friendship Master - Configure Friendship Decay Talking and Gift Rules
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Friendship Master[/size][/b][/center]
[i]Complete control over your social life in Stardew Valley. Whether you want to stop friendship decay entirely, speed up relationship progress, or create a realistic schedule where you are more social on weekends, this mod handles it all.
[/i]
[quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/quote]

[b][size=4]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Decay Control:[/b] Adjust the rate at which friendship drops when you don't talk to villagers. Set it to 0% to never lose hearts again, or adjust the multiplier to simply slow it down.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Conversation Boost:[/b] Configure how many extra friendship points you get simply for talking to an NPC.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Extra Gifts:[/b] Bypass the "one gift per day" limit. Use a slider to allow up to 10 additional gifts per day for faster progression.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Safe & Stable:[/b] Uses a "Snapshot" system that calculates decay safely overnight. This avoids dangerous code patches, ensuring maximum compatibility with other mods.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Optional logging to the SMAPI console so you can verify exactly how many points you lost or gained overnight.
[/list][b][size=4]Two Game Modes
[/size][/b]
You can toggle between these modes in the config menu:

[b]1. Constant Mode
[/b]
Global settings that apply every day. Perfect if you just want to disable decay globally or always allow 1 extra gift per day.

[b]2. Adaptive Mode
[/b]
For players who want a dynamic schedule. This allows you to set specific rules for specific days of the week.

[list]
[*][b]Example:[/b] You could set Monday-Friday to have normal decay and limits, but set Saturday and Sunday to have [b]No Decay[/b] and [b]+3 Extra Gifts[/b]. This lets you ignore villagers during the work week and catch up on friendships during the weekend!
[/list]

Configuration
[/size][/b]
This mod relies on [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for setup.

[list=1]
[*]Open the game.

[*]Click the [b]Gear Icon[/b] on the title screen (or the "Mod Options" button in the in-game menu).

[*]Select [b]Friendship Master[/b].

[*][b]General:[/b] Toggle Adaptive Mode or Debug Mode.

[*][b]Constant Mode:[/b] Set your global defaults.

[*][b]Adaptive Schedule:[/b] Scroll down to configure each day of the week individually.

[/list][b][size=4]Requirements & Installation
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly Recommended for easy configuration).
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Run the game.
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*]Works in Multiplayer (Client-side mod; each player can have their own friendship rules).
[*]Compatible with custom NPC mods (Ridgeview, Expanded, etc.).
[/list]
